Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Subramonium Prasad
 Order
% 15.07.2024 CRL.M.A. 20434/2024 (Exemption) Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

1. The present appeal under Section 347(2) read with Section 482 Cr.P.C has been filed against the Judgment dated 06.07.2023 and the Order on Sentence dated 30.04.2024 passed by the Ld. ASJ (FTSC), (POCSO), North District, Rohini Courts by which the Appellant has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 20 years along with fine of Rs.2,000/- for the offence committed under Section 376(2) of IPC and in case of default of payment further imprisonment of one month, rigorous imprisonment for a period of 4 years alongwith a fine of Rs.2,000/- for the offence committed under Section 506 IPC and in case of default of payment further imprisonment of one month and imprisonment for a period of 6 This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 18/07/2024 at 22:33:31 months alongwith a fine of Rs.1,000/- for the offence committed under Section 342 IPC and in case of default of payment further imprisonment of 15 days.
2.
Let a digitized copy of Trial Court Record (TCR) be summoned before the next date of hearing.
3. Nominal role be also called before the next date of hearing.
4. Notice be issued to the prosecurtrix.
